chains.name: Succession intervention creates a personal conflict
chains.prerequisites: Dynast, same dynasty, target not disinherited; culture, strong-hook, realm and diarch restrictions apply.
chains.actual_spend_or_tradeoff: Renown and prestige expressions in interaction cost; forgiving/compassionate actor gains stress and legitimacy can fall. Disputed heritage/bastardy and puppet branches alter cost.
chains.state_mutation: disinherited trait; opinion and rival/potential-rival edges, possibly with replacement heir.
chains.later_consumer: Trait declares dynasty inheritance blocker; stress on-actions dispatch threshold events; restore interaction removes blocker and selectively cleans opinions.
chains.time_or_absence: Trait lasts until explicitly restored; usurped-authority opinion branch lasts20years.
chains.failure_and_aftermath: Invalid relationship/culture/standing blocks action. Restoration is not a blanket undo: reviewed helper removes trait/opinions, not every rival edge.

chains.name: Relief changes the person who takes it
chains.prerequisites: Stress threshold and cooldown gates; un-imprisoned dispatch, eligible coping-option flag.
chains.actual_spend_or_tradeoff: Immediate stress reduction buys a persistent health/stewardship/prowess/travel-safety penalty; existing drinker gets an additional binge penalty.
chains.state_mutation: Add drunkard trait or three-year stress_drinking_binge modifier.
chains.later_consumer: Trait and modifier feed health/skills/stress-loss statistics; later threshold choices distinguish existing coping traits.
chains.time_or_absence: Three-year binge; threshold aftereffects schedule a five-year follow-up, eight with mental_resilience. One-day guard prevents same-day recursive breaks.
chains.failure_and_aftermath: Eligible option can be absent. Native modifier evaluation not recovered; reduced stress does not erase the new trait or scheduled eligibility.

chains.name: Confiding produces a repeatable social routine
chains.prerequisites: Confider trait and availability; events require an existing flagged friend or an eligible adult non-rival courtier.
chains.decision: Use stress_loss_confider_decision and confirm dispatched event.
chains.actual_spend_or_tradeoff: 1095-day decision cooldown; outsider courtier opinions fall10 while existing confidant gains5, alongside trait-conditioned stress relief. No currency debit in reviewed decision.
chains.state_mutation: Create friend relation if necessary and set has_been_confided_in relation flag.
chains.later_consumer: Next7001/7002 event selects branch using that flag. Actual changes are in event, while decision show_as_tooltip only previews them.
chains.time_or_absence: 1095days between decisions; AI checks use36-month tier intervals.
chains.failure_and_aftermath: Without eligible people the reviewed7001/7002 triggers fail. Dispatcher fallback behavior is native/unrecovered. Decision preview says envy modifier but actual7001 uses friendliness with negative opinion: execution is authority.

chains.name: A branch family gains identity and an heirloom claim
chains.prerequisites: Adult with living child of same house; not house head; succession distance, government, marriage and special regional gates differ.
chains.actual_spend_or_tradeoff: Reviewed ordinary route grants prestige, not a currency spend; eligibility and loss/change of house affiliation are the tradeoff.
chains.state_mutation: Create named house; notify members; add a house claim on an in-range dynasty banner if one qualifies.
chains.later_consumer: Artifact claimant lists and regional struggle catalysts consume the new house; administrative family setup is called conditionally.
chains.time_or_absence: AI interval varies by title tier; extra AI child/succession restrictions bound repeated branch creation.
chains.failure_and_aftermath: No eligible banner means no artifact claim. Japanese/TGP route dispatches a separate event that was not followed; native create-house membership propagation is unrecovered.

chains.name: A death becomes remembered context for later scenes
chains.prerequisites: on_death family/spouse scopes and relation-specific exclusions.
chains.decision: Death event creates relative/spouse memory; later scenes select remembered deceased.
chains.actual_spend_or_tradeoff: No resource spend in reviewed memory creation. Retaining a participant pins that character against save pruning according to shipped authoring contract.
chains.state_mutation: Typed memory, participant IDs; childhood variable for a young family member.
chains.later_consumer: Relative/spouse definition renders perspective and known-killer context. False-conversion vulnerability checks loss memory and selects a remembered deceased by creation date. Funeral sample reads friend/rival loss memory for scene tone.
chains.time_or_absence: Default scripted duration5years plus relevance additions125/25/195years; native fallback define10years is separate. Death retention differs by tier and played-character status.
chains.failure_and_aftermath: Expired/missing memory cannot pass reviewed memory gates. Native expiry scheduler and referenced-object pruning traversal were not recovered. Funeral sample is a related memory consumer, not proof that its specific relative memory is used in the shown branch.

chains.name: History is authored facts, not the save serializer
chains.prerequisites: Character IDs link father/mother/dynasty, with dated birth/death records in English sample.
chains.decision: An author supplies dated starting-world facts; this is not a player choice.
chains.actual_spend_or_tradeoff: No spend or dynamic compaction operation in sample.
chains.state_mutation: Date-qualified birth/death and parent IDs establish initial biography.
chains.later_consumer: History database loader and family system are native consumers, inferred from file schema rather than recovered code.
chains.time_or_absence: Explicit calendar dates, plus define for historical child personality-trait ages9/11/13.
chains.failure_and_aftermath: No evidence that source history files serialize played lives. Loader error/min-parent-age define is configuration evidence only. No save inspected and no native history compactor recovered.

read_scope: 533 post-immediate hook;647-694 alcohol choice;775-788 after hook
2997-3078 cadet branch gains, artifact claim and catalysts

source_limits: Script contracts and configured values are verified locally; actual execution is not.
Native stress evaluation, history loader, serializer/compression/prune traversal are unrecovered.
Search hits were used to select blocks; raw file counts are not read coverage.
F6 is a history-schema boundary finding, not a sixth player decision loop. Five player/event chains are F1-F5.
original_design_note: P1-P5 are original proposals, not accepted decisions or a request to clone CK3 content.
